integrity: Standalone exact-fraction checker and analytic proof included; the finite checks supplement rather than prove the universal result.
scientific_limitations: The law concerns only symmetric couplings of two uniform variables with absolute difference constrained to d or 2d for 0<d<=1/2. It gives the full attainable long-jump mass interval, not optimizer uniqueness, other displacement alphabets or unequal margins. The deterministic envelope is known from a prior one-distance calculation. Independent validation is not performed.
title: Sharp two-distance composition law for exchangeable uniform couplings
